info.title: RAG Chatbot API
info.description: Knowledge-grounded chatbot: public chat API for frontends and an admin API for the management web.

get.description: Always 200 while the server is running.
200 when the database answers and services are built; 503 otherwise.

post.summary: Ask a question; answer streamed as Server-Sent Events
post.description:
Stream the answer to one message.

Events: ``meta`` (conversation_id, message_id), ``delta`` (text pieces),
``done`` (outcome, full text, citations, handoff_id) or ``error``.
Quota and validation failures are returned as normal HTTP errors before
the stream starts.

post.summary: Ask a question; complete answer as JSON
post.description: Non-streaming counterpart of ``/chat/stream`` for server-to-server integrations.

get.description: The visitor's own conversation, to restore the widget after a page reload.

post.description: Rate an assistant answer (thumbs up/down, optional comment).

get.description: Title, welcome text, colour and suggested questions configured in the admin web.

post.description:
Exchange e-mail and password for a session token.

The token is also set as an HttpOnly cookie scoped to the admin API, which
is what the admin web uses; scripts use the returned token as a Bearer.
Clear the session cookie (open to anyone: it only removes the caller's own cookie).

get.description: The signed-in admin.
All admin accounts.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Admin Users Get

patch.description: Change an admin's role or disable the account.

get.description: Every source with its document count.

schema.title: Response List Sources Api V1 Admin Knowledge Sources Get

patch.description: Rename, re-describe, re-prioritize or enable/disable a source.

get.description: Documents newest first, filterable by source, status and title/filename.

post.description:
Upload a file into a source. Parsing and embedding continue in the
background; poll the document until its status is ``ready`` or ``failed``.
Create a document from typed text (searchable immediately).

get.description: A document with all of its chunks.

patch.description: Edit title, source, metadata or enabled flag.

delete.description: Delete a document and its chunks.

post.description: Insert a chunk into a document.

patch.description: Edit a chunk's text (re-embedded automatically) and/or metadata.

get.description: Chunking strategies with their parameter schemas (for the upload and re-chunk forms).

schema.title: Response List Chunking Strategies Api V1 Admin Knowledge Chunking Strategies Get

post.description: What a strategy would make of the document's stored text; nothing is saved.
Replace the document's chunks with its stored text split by the given strategy.

get.description: Conversations, most recently active first.

parameters.name: outcome

schema.description: Only conversations with such an answer
schema.title: Outcome

parameters.description: Only conversations with such an answer

get.description: One conversation with every message, its diagnostics and feedback.
Visitor ratings newest first, with the question and the rated answer.
Transfer-to-human requests newest first.

patch.description: Mark a handoff in progress or resolved, optionally with a note.

get.description: Tokens per day and model, per purpose, answer outcomes, feedback and latency.

schema.title: Response Usage Summary Api V1 Admin Usage Summary Get

get.summary: Live feed of chat turns and handoffs (SSE)
get.description: Streams a ``turn`` event after every answered message and a ``handoff`` event per new request.
Recent application log entries, newest first (personal data already redacted).

schema.title: Response Logs Api V1 Admin Logs Get

get.description: Health, index size, models, cache statistics and the upload queue.

post.description: Rebuild the in-memory search index from the database.

get.description: Current fallback mode, canned replies, assistant instructions and widget look.

schema.title: Response Get Settings Api V1 Admin Settings Get

patch.description:
Change settings; they apply to the next chat turn without a restart.

A new chat or light model is tried with one tiny request first, so a
mistyped model name is refused (400) instead of breaking every chat.

schema.title: Response Update Settings Api V1 Admin Settings Patch

get.description: What each setting falls back to (``.env`` / built-in), to show saved overrides.

schema.title: Response Get Setting Defaults Api V1 Admin Settings Defaults Get

delete.description: Drop a saved override so the default applies again.

schema.title: Response Reset Setting Api V1 Admin Settings  Key  Delete

get.description: Every client API key (secrets are never shown again).

schema.title: Response List Api Keys Api V1 Admin Api Keys Get

post.description: Issue a key for a frontend; copy it now, it is not retrievable later.
Revoke a key (effective within a minute).

get.description: Admin writes and sign-in attempts, newest first. There is no way to edit or delete them.
